about: Real Raydium CLMM (CAMMCzo5..., the layout the venue's range program shares) swaps from mainnet-beta, read 2026-10-24 by getTransaction (encoding json, maxSupportedTransactionVersion 0; the version 1 ones were left out). The signatures and recorded events are those of src/lib/solana/clmm/__fixtures__/mainnet-swaps.json. Only the log, the outcome and the instruction trace are kept: which program each instruction and inner instruction ran, by account index, with the accounts that index reads.
